purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0149 in the gravity arena: gravity as a lapse on the one-body register band, fail on H1 as predicted: the rule's own lapse (the local step angle) drops a packet at rest at exactly E/m* times the gradient (to 1e-5) and its equivalence ratio is 1/R to 3e-4 at five rest gaps (0.996 to 0.642), so universality at rest is R = 1; a moving packet falls by its mass M dE/dM, not its energy (to 9e-5), up to 1.57 times E/m*; both bands fall alike.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
